description:
## [1.41.0](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/compare/v1.40.0...v1.41.0) (2026-08-25)

### ✨ New Features

* Add Calendar Premium Patch https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=calendar.agenda.schedule.event.advance.calendar.planner
* Add Rs File Explorer Disable Rate Dialog Patch ([d183190](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches/commit/d1831909be29bd155f94c28e1411d9cd1fb16ae6))
* Update Drawable Clean Patch To Remove More Junk Dpi

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.

patches.name: Clean main UI
patches.description: Hides the bottom navigation bar, the top-right guide icon, and the Rate/Help/About drawer items, keeps the connect/create/join buttons on top, and stops them from being auto-hidden. Reapplied on create, resume, and drawer open (and retried for ~1.8s after each) since some of these views are inflated lazily.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation entirely. Also restores the storage-permission request and local media scan that the splash screen normally performs, so the Apps/Photo/Video tabs still load.

patches.name: Speed up splash screen
patches.description: Enters the main activity directly after the splash permission check instead of delaying for the additional external-storage check.

patches.name: ES File Explorer Ui Cleanup
patches.description: Removes BookMark, New Files, Cleaner Row In HomePage, Cleans More menu actions

patches.name: Hide File Transfer, Video Playlist, Private Folder tiles
patches.description: Removes the File Transfer, Video Playlist, and Private Folder tiles from the tools tile list.

patches.name: Hide local tiles banner
patches.description: Collapses the local device tiles banner.

patches.name: Hide Me tab promo items
patches.description: Collapses the WhatsApp, Legal, and Help entries on the Me tab.

patches.name: Skip welcome screen
patches.description: Moves the launcher intent filters and app shortcuts from the welcome/splash activity to the main activity, so the app boots straight past the splash and update screen.

patches.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches.description: Strips RsDownloadActivity's file-extension and scheme/mimeType intent filters so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches.name: Disable rate us dialog
patches.description: Overrides show() on the in-app "rate us" dialog so it's still built but never displayed.

patches.name: Hide more actions
patches.description: Hides Hide, Add to desktop, Encrypt, Decrypt, Add bookmark, Web Search, Copy to, Move to, Transfer, and Playing from the "More actions" menu.

patches.name: Hide network, tools and bookmarks on home page
patches.description: Hides the Network, Tools and Bookmarks sections from the home page section list.

patches.name: Skip splash screen
patches.description: Moves the launcher intent filter to the main activity and calls the all-files-access permission request directly, instead of showing the splash activity and its full-screen 'grant storage access' dialog.

patches.name: Clean SnapTube Settings Page
patches.description: Removes the Download tools and Phone clean categories, and their sub-items, from Settings.

patches.name: Disable Annoying Snaptube Notifications
patches.description: Turns off the Toolbar, Recommended contents, and Tool notifications channels by default.

patches.name: Remove Watch Ad To Download
patches.description: Removes the requirement to watch a rewarded ad before a download starts.

patches.name: Disable ad dialog when reopening app
patches.description: Prevents the full-screen "loading ad" dialog from appearing when the app is reopened after being minimized.

patches.name: Disable downloader from download menu
patches.description: Strips WebDownloadActivity's scheme/mimeType/host/pathPattern intent-filter data (action and category tags kept) so it no longer offers itself as a handler in the system download/"complete action using" chooser.

patches.name: Skip splash and language screens
patches.description: Jumps straight to the main activity from the splash screen, skipping the splash animation, the language-selection screen, and any ad/app-open dialog normally shown first.
